name: Fristen-Erinnerung im Ereignisfall an den Owner (ko): Kopf, überfällig/fällig im Owner-Locale, Hinweis, Knöpfe
reset_sql: DELETE FROM core.notification_state WHERE source = 'estate' AND key LIKE 'case_task:%';
DELETE FROM estate.cases WHERE subject_person_id = 'lisa' AND flags ? 'cron_text_test';
seed_sql: WITH c AS (INSERT INTO estate.cases (case_type, subject_person_id, event_date, knowledge_date, bundesland, flags) VALUES ('incapacity', 'lisa', CURRENT_DATE - 5, CURRENT_DATE - 5, 'berlin', '{"cron_text_test": true}'::jsonb) RETURNING id) INSERT INTO estate.case_tasks (case_id, phase, title, due_date, hardness) SELECT c.id, v.phase, v.title, v.due, v.hard FROM c, (VALUES ('immediate', 'CRONTEXT A1', CURRENT_DATE - 1, 'critical'), ('first_week', 'CRONTEXT B1', CURRENT_DATE + 2, 'recommended')) AS v(phase, title, due, hard);

name: Fristen-Erinnerung (ko) für eine Vorlagen-Aufgabe mit deutschem Bestands-Schnappschuss: Titel aus dem Katalog in Owner-Sprache, nicht der gespeicherte deutsche Text
reset_sql: DELETE FROM core.notification_state WHERE source = 'estate' AND key LIKE 'case_task:%';
DELETE FROM estate.cases WHERE subject_person_id = 'lisa' AND flags ? 'cron_text_test';
seed_sql: WITH c AS (INSERT INTO estate.cases (case_type, subject_person_id, event_date, knowledge_date, bundesland, flags) VALUES ('incapacity', 'lisa', CURRENT_DATE - 5, CURRENT_DATE - 5, 'berlin', '{"cron_text_test": true}'::jsonb) RETURNING id) INSERT INTO estate.case_tasks (case_id, template_key, phase, title, due_date, hardness) SELECT c.id, 'present_patient_directive', 'immediate', 'Patientenverfügung den behandelnden Ärzten vorlegen', CURRENT_DATE - 1, 'recommended' FROM c;
notes: Bestand vor estate:V003: case_tasks trägt den deutschen Vorlagen-Text als Schnappschuss; der Versand rendert Vorlagen-Aufgaben aus dem Katalog (estate.task.<key>.title) in der Empfänger-Sprache. expect_keys prüft auch, dass die deutschen Teilstücke fehlen.
